title: How to Watch Free Live TV Online in 2026 (Legal Channels, No Sign-Up)
html:
You do not need a cable box, a subscription or even an account to watch live TV. Hundreds of broadcasters stream their channels for free, legally, to anyone with a browser. The hard part is finding them in one place.

The short answer: open Riftn TV in any browser. It gathers free, publicly available live channels from around the world, groups them by country and genre, and plays them with no account and no subscription. For more choice, add an ad-supported service such as Pluto TV, and your national broadcaster's own player.

Watch free live TV on Riftn in three steps

  1. Open riftn.com/tv on a phone, laptop or smart TV browser. No sign-up.
  2. Pick a country or a genre: news, sport, film, music, kids or documentary. Or search a channel by name.
  3. Press play. The player can shrink into a corner while you keep browsing, and a live chat runs beside the channel.

Every channel in the guide is a free stream that the broadcaster itself makes public. If one stops working, the player reports it so it can be fixed or removed.

Is free live TV legal?

Yes, when the broadcaster offers the stream for free. Many public and commercial broadcasters stream their own channels openly, paid for by advertising or by a licence fee in their home country. Watching those streams is legal.

What is not legal is a paid IPTV subscription that resells premium channels, such as sports packages or movie networks, for a few euros a month. Those services do not hold the rights. They also tend to vanish overnight, and some steal card details. If a deal offers every sports channel on earth for less than a coffee, it is not a real deal.

Where to watch free live TV online

  • Riftn TV: free channels from around the world, grouped by country and genre. No account. Plays in the browser and in the Riftn apps, with live chat.
  • Pluto TV: hundreds of themed channels, paid for by ads. No account needed. Available in the US, much of Europe and Latin America.
  • Samsung TV Plus: free ad-supported channels on Samsung TVs and phones, and on the web in some countries.
  • The Roku Channel, Tubi and Plex: free live channels alongside on-demand films, mainly in the US. Some need a free account.
  • Your national broadcaster: BBC iPlayer, ARD and ZDF, France.tv, RTVE Play and TRT all stream live in their home country. Some need a free account, and BBC iPlayer needs a UK TV licence.
  • News channels on video platforms: Al Jazeera, France 24, DW and many others stream live around the clock for free.

Free live TV by language

Riftn TV lists channels by country, so you can watch in your own language wherever you are:

  • Arabic: pan-Arab news channels and national broadcasters, grouped under Arabic news.
  • Spanish: news and general channels from Spain and Latin America, with a Spanish news group.
  • French: channels from France and other French-speaking countries.
  • Turkish: national and regional channels from Turkey.

Some channels limit their stream to viewers in their home country. When that happens, Riftn TV tells you the channel is geo-blocked instead of showing a black screen.

Tips for a better stream

  • Use a wired connection or strong Wi-Fi for sport. Many free streams run at 720p or 1080p.
  • Open the browser on your smart TV, or cast from a phone, to watch on the big screen.
  • Try another channel in the same genre if one buffers. Free streams depend on the broadcaster's own servers.

Frequently asked questions

Can I watch live TV online for free without signing up?

Yes. Riftn TV and Pluto TV both play live channels without an account.

Is it legal to watch free TV channels online?

Yes, when the broadcaster offers the stream for free. Paid IPTV boxes and subscriptions that resell premium channels are not legal.

Can I watch live sport for free?

Some. Free channels carry news, highlights, motor sport, combat sport and smaller leagues. Top football leagues and the biggest events usually sit behind paid rights, so a free stream of them is rarely legal.

Why does a channel say it is geo-blocked?

The broadcaster limits that stream to viewers in its home country, usually because of rights deals. Pick another channel in the same genre.

Does Riftn TV work on a smart TV?

Yes. Open riftn.com/tv in the TV's browser, or cast it from your phone.

Riftn is a social media protocol: creators can go live there too, and their streams sit in the same guide as the broadcasters. Start watching on Riftn TV.
